name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted error tracking compatible with Sentry SDKs, backed by PostgreSQL, with stacktraces, local variables and alerts.

alerts.message: The first start creates a superuser from ADMIN_EMAIL (admin@example.com) and the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD in the environment. Sign in with them, then change the password. Email alerts need EMAIL_HOST and the related SMTP settings added to the environment.
